content.short: Multi-currency business accounts with IBANs, US accounts and USDC wallets, paying out in 50+ markets.
content.description: Virtua Broker gives companies one dashboard for euro IBANs, US ACH and wire accounts, accounts in currencies such as BRL, and USDC wallets. Funds can be converted and sent through local rails in more than 50 markets across the Americas, Europe, Asia and Africa, using its own network to cut intermediaries. Payments, FX, treasury and compliance share one API and ledger.
content.meta: Hold EUR, USD, BRL and USDC in one Virtua Broker dashboard and pay out through local rails in 50+ markets.
